detail.longDescription: I built DCIM for people who have a personal website and want an easy way to put photos on it. You upload photos from your browser and paste the embed into HTML or Markdown. You can also send someone a link to the album. You host DCIM in your own Cloudflare account, which gives you 10GB of free storage. Using another S3-compatible bucket is also possible. I know I use the term "self-hosted" loosely here, but the main benefit of such small software is that you can modify it to your liking (customizable software!) and quickly deploy it on Cloudflare for free.
